[[File:Len and Anne.png|thumb|250px|Len and Anne (right) during a performance]] '''Anne''' (Japanese: '''アンヌ''' ''Anne'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP090|Stage Fight]]''. Anne was a member of the [[Pokémon Showboat]] Crew along with [[Roger]], [[Kay]], and [[Len]]. One of her most popular voice overs for the Pokémon show was that of {{p|Clefable}}. When {{TRT}} boarded their boat and held their Pokémon captive, Anne helped trick Team Rocket into believing all of the Pokémon knew how to talk. {{-}} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} ===Status unknown=== These Pokémon, along with [[Kay]]'s {{p|Raichu}}, are present on the Pokémon Showboat.
